method: Press: one clean headless Chromium per batch (no profile, no login, no paywall bypass); cookie banners rejected, never accepted; notices that offer no reject option and ad slots hidden locally for the screenshot only; sites that answered with a bot block (401/403) were skipped, not evaded. Crop = masthead + headline + dek + date (+ lead image where the date sits under it). X: read-only in the presenter's logged-in Chrome (new tab, no interaction), counts are the exact integers from each post's action bar plus the strings X displayed; crops exclude the viewer's account, avatar and reply box. Long posts were captured in two scrolls of the same post and joined at a blank row.
